location: Published p. 225 (PDF p. 2), Method > Participants; p. 226 (PDF p. 3), Results
quote: Participants were 29 individuals with a clinical diagnosis … of OCD and 29 participants without psychiatric history
reason: The analytic sample comprises 58 participants (29 with OCD included in the study after 1 screening exclusion plus 29 matched controls), which is corroborated by the 2×2 between-subjects ANOVA residual degrees of freedom, F(1, 54). The shipped value of 57 erroneously subtracted the single excluded participant from the post-exclusion total of 58.
